name: mangoidiots-solitaire
description: Offline-first Mangoidiots Draw 1 Klondike with Chola and Mughal themes on GitHub Pages.

scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run preview
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run assets && node tools/build.mjs
scripts.test: node --test tests/game.test.mjs tests/scoring.test.mjs tests/themes.test.mjs tests/mughal-theme.test.mjs tests/drop-targets.test.mjs tests/identity.test.mjs tests/pages.test.mjs && playwright test
